text: {"name":"rf_dump_settings","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Emits diagnostic lines for RF temperature compensation, crystal-capacitor and band-offset calibration values, and settings status.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"v0":"calibration_config","v1":"settings_enabled","v2":"task_lookup_result","v4":"settings_timer"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"temperature-compensation initialization flag"},{"offset":1,"meaning":"temperature-compensation enable flag"},{"offset":2,"meaning":"temperature-compensation calibration level"},{"offset":3,"meaning":"last recorded temperature"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"crystal-capacitor calibration value"},{"offset":5,"meaning":"crystal-capacitor target value"},{"offset":6,"meaning":"current crystal-capacitor value"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"2.4 GHz calibration offset entry 0"},{"offset":9,"meaning":"2.4 GHz calibration offset entry 1"},{"offset":10,"meaning":"2.4 GHz calibration offset entry 2"},{"offset":11,"meaning":"5 GHz calibration offset entry 0"},{"offset":12,"meaning":"5 GHz calibration offset entry 1"},{"offset":13,"meaning":"5 GHz calibration offset entry 2"},{"offset":360,"meaning":"settings enable value"},{"offset":364,"meaning":"settings timer value"}]}
